author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸುಜ್ಞಾನಿಯ ಜೊತೆಯಿರಲು ಸತ್ಯವನು ಹುಡುಕುವೆನು
ಅಜ್ಞಾನಿಯಾಗಿಹೆನು ಎಲ್ಲ ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿಬಿಡಿ
ಅಜ್ಞನಾಗಿಹ ನಾನು ಮಂಥನವ ಮಾಡುತಲೆ
ತಜ್ಞನಾಗುವ ಆಸೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Keeping company with the wise, I search for truth;
I am the ignorant one; forgive me everything;
ignorant as I am, by churning things over
I hope to become an expert, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A companion verse to the previous one: the poet humbly calls himself unlearned, asks pardon, and says his hope is simply to grow in knowledge through the company of the wise and careful reflection.
